messages:
Priya Nair: Hey all ":wave:" just started and my kit arrived but the USB-C -> Ethernet dongle is missing. Monitor, stand, and dock accounted for.

it-support-bot: Sorry about that, Priya. I've logged ticket IT-4922 and looped in Delivery Ops. Can you confirm the SKU on the packing slip?

Priya Nair: Packing slip SKU: RDW-START-2026. No photo, I tossed outer box but kept slip.

Delivery Ops: Thanks — expedited replacement requested. We'll post tracking here once generated. ETA 48-72 hours. Ref SHIP-99701.

Priya Nair: Appreciate it. Do we need to return anything or leave a note?

it-support-bot: No return required for missing accessories. If you kept any foam/pouch, please hold for 48 hours in case we ask for photos. Otherwise we'll ship replacement only.

Tom Rivera: Welcome Priya! Quick workaround: you can tether your laptop to your phone hotspot and use the dock over USB for now. I also have a spare dongle in the SF bulk box if you want me to drop it by later today.

Priya Nair: That would be great — I'm at desk SF-3A. Thanks Tom!

Facilities Bot: Noted. Also saw a note about cable length mismatches in similar kits this week — Facilities will reconcile inventory during the next pack audit.

Priya Nair: One more thing — the monitor arm came with a slightly stripped screw, I tightened it but thought ops should know.

Delivery Ops: Filing a quality feedback ticket for pack team. Thanks for flagging.

it-support-bot: When replacement arrives, plug it in and run `ifconfig` (mac: `ifconfig |grep inet`) and paste a short snippet if you have trouble. If Tom drops by with a spare, mark the IT ticket as "temp resolved" until the official part arrives.

Priya Nair: Will do. Thanks everyone for the rapid help :heart:
